sn40.3:1.4: idha bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā upekhako viharati, sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti, yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekhako satimā sukhavihārīti. taṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
sn40.3:1.6: so khvāhaṃ āvuso pītiyā ca virāgā upekhako ca viharāmi, sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedemi. yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekhako satimā sukhavihārīti taṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn40.3:1.7: tassa mayhaṃ āvuso iminā vihārena viharato pītisahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.
sn40.3:2.1: atha kho maṃ āvuso bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca:
sn40.3:2.3: mā brāhmaṇa, tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ pamādo, tatiye jhāne cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi, tatiye jhāne cittaṃ ekodiṃ karohi tatiye jhāne cittaṃ samādahāti.
sn40.3:2.4: so khvāhaṃ āvuso aparena samayena pītiyā ca virāgā upekhako ca vihāsiṃ sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedesiṃ. yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekhako satimā sukhavihārīti taṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
sn40.3:2.5: yaṃ hi taṃ āvuso sammāvadamāno vadeyya satthārānuggahito sāvako mahābhiññataṃ pattoti. mamaṃ taṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya satthārānuggahito sāvako mahābhiññataṃ pattoti.
